title: An unowned url slot is judged only on the pages its block prints
steps: S1: In the TCH checkout with dependencies installed, run run.cmd (no database needed).
S2: Confirm every test named in run.tests reports ok.
expect: A url slot printed only on /page-1 is a warning when only the home page links that page, and a block when its own page shows the link.

tests: an unowned url slot is judged only on the pages its block prints, not where another block links the same page
